title: Career Enhancement for PMETs with Government Schemes
what_it_is: Career Enhancement for PMETs with Government Schemes

sections.label: Local PMET career opportunities update
sections.summary: A question asks the Minister for Manpower for an update on whether local PMETs have enhanced career opportunities from Government interventions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether he can provide an update on whether local PMETs have enhanced career opportunities as a result of various Government interventions.

sections.label: Manpower growth slowing
sections.summary: Manpower growth slowed from 4% in 2014 to 2% in 2015 and to 1% last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Manpower growth has slowed from 4% in 2014 to 2% in 2015, and to 1% last year.

sections.label: Local PMET ratio and median incomes
sections.summary: The three-year moving average rose from about 50% to about 75%, and real median incomes rose 4.3% per annum from 2014 to 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: The three-year moving average has improved significantly over the last few years, from about 50% five years ago – in other words, one local PMET versus one foreign PMET – to about 75% in the past three years – or three local PMETs versus one foreign PMET (Annex B).

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Likewise, real median incomes, including employer Central Provident Fund (CPF) contributions of full-time employed residents, have risen by 4.3% per annum from 2014 to 2016, much higher than 2.4% per annum from 2011 to 2014.

sections.label: A&G job placements breakdown
sections.summary: In the first eight months, over 16,000 job placements were made, with 58% PMETs, 53% over 40, and 30% long-term unemployed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: As a result, the number of local jobseekers who secured jobs successfully with the help of the A&G programmes has continued to increase and remain inclusive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In the first eight months of this year, out of more than 16,000 successful job placements, more than half of them, or 58%, are PMETs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: And more than half, or 53%, are more than 40 years old, and almost 30%, to be exact 29%, are more than 50 years old; and 30% were long-term unemployed before we found jobs for them.

sections.label: PCP alignment with ITMs
sections.summary: A question asks how the PCP is aligned to the ITMs to support career switches, noting 70% of redundancy-affected workers are PMETs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: Specifically, as we see the Government rolling out the ITMs, I would like to ask the Minister, how is the PCP aligned to the ITMs so as to support career-switch efforts towards growth sectors, so that it is very targeted, and also, with the close involvement of prospective employers in the design and delivery of internship and training programmes?

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: This time round, we can see that 70% of the workers affected by redundancy are the PMETs.

sections.label: Higher wage support for PCP
sections.summary: Higher wage support of up to 90% is given, spread over a longer duration of up to 18 months for the PCP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: For example, we give them a higher wage support of up to 90%, spread out over a longer duration for the PCP of up to 18 months, and so on.

sections.label: PCP and ITM alignment
sections.summary: About five of the 23 ITM sectors are assessed to contribute about 60% of medium-term PMET job creation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: On the question about how PCP aligns with ITM, this is a very important question.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: We look at the 23 ITM sectors and our assessment is that about five sectors will contribute to about 60% of the PMET job creation in the medium term.

sections.label: SME programme participation growth
sections.summary: About 2,000 SMEs took part last year, and after about 20 months the total has exceeded 5,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Last year, about 2,000 SMEs took part in this programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: By now, after about 20 months, the total number has exceeded 5,000.

sections.label: PMET placement success rate
sections.summary: For PMETs who need additional help and come to WSG or e2i, the success rate is about 65%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Of those who need additional help and come to WSG or e2i, for the PMETs, our success rate is about 65%.

sections.label: Placement inclusivity by race and gender
sections.summary: Breakdowns by racial group and gender are quite inclusive, with minority racial groups' placement percentage higher than the workforce average.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: From the numbers that I have seen so far, by breakdown in terms of racial groups and gender, they are quite inclusive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: In fact, if I remember correctly – I stand to be corrected – the percentage of the minority racial groups who are successfully placed is, in fact, higher than the workforce average.
